units.source: When an empty __TRILIUM_PH_0__Text__TRILIUM_PH_1__ note is created, a note type switcher will appear below the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Title__TRILIUM_PH_3__, at the top of the content. With the __TRILIUM_PH_4__Compact__TRILIUM_PH_5__ note title (see __TRILIUM_PH_6__Title__TRILIUM_PH_7__), it appears at the bottom of the note instead. Apart from changing the note type, it's also possible to apply a __TRILIUM_PH_8__template__TRILIUM_PH_9__:
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Canvas__TRILIUM_PH_5__ switch the note to that type in one click.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Code__TRILIUM_PH_2__ lists the scripting notes (__TRILIUM_PH_3__Custom CSS__TRILIUM_PH_4__, __TRILIUM_PH_5__Widget__TRILIUM_PH_6__ and __TRILIUM_PH_7__Backend script__TRILIUM_PH_8__), then the enabled code languages.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Collection__TRILIUM_PH_2__ and __TRILIUM_PH_3____TRILIUM_PH_4__Template__TRILIUM_PH_5__ list the collections and the templates.

__TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__All types__TRILIUM_PH_2__ displays the same menu as __TRILIUM_PH_3__Insert note after__TRILIUM_PH_4__ in the __TRILIUM_PH_5__Note tree contextual menu__TRILIUM_PH_6__, with every note type and template.

Typing while the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__Code__TRILIUM_PH_2__, __TRILIUM_PH_3__ __TRILIUM_PH_4__Template__TRILIUM_PH_5__ or __TRILIUM_PH_6__ __TRILIUM_PH_7__All types__TRILIUM_PH_8__ menu is open narrows it down to the matching entries.
The switcher will disappear as soon as a text is entered.
